name: nexus
description: Event-driven microservices platform for WhatsApp AI agents

scripts.dev: pnpm -C apps/api dev & pnpm -C apps/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm -C packages/shared build && pnpm -C apps/api build && pnpm -C apps/web build
scripts.test: pnpm -C packages/shared test && pnpm -C apps/api test && pnpm -C apps/engine test
scripts.lint: pnpm -C apps/api lint && pnpm -C apps/web lint
